independentDerivationAndChecks: Independently rebuilt the P108 budget: weighted row census, Abel identity, sorted diagonal rank bound u_i<=2i-1, concave tangent of2-1/(1-z), retained chronological prefix slack; victim envelope/Hall swap; two-anchor rational certificate; immortal mean and deficit budgets; chord lower bound; disjoint column service integration. Every error is O_{a, C}(1), not an unproved o(N). Detailed derivation is in the adjacent document.

Set P_m=sum_{i<=m}[A(d(i-1))-A(u_i)]>=0. Abel gives weighted slack=P_N/N^2+J_N, J_N=2 integral_1^N P_floor(t)/t^3dt. Retaining this term strengthens budget to kappa_a Ecal_a+J<=D(a)logX+O(1), with kappa>.1336 and D(a)=aP(a)/[(1-a)(3a+1)(6a^2+9a+2)].

Every missing numerical rank r<=m is replaced by an emitted rank>m, giving P_m>=sum_missing[A(u_(m+1))-A(u_r)]. On a near-linear counting profile, anη fraction of ε-low chronological rows has rank delay>=δN. Each missing label persists over at leastδN/5 prefix indices, contributing at least aδN/4 each. Weighted energy per bad row>=aδ²/(10N), so J_local>=aηδ²/100. Lower bound d(i-1)>=i already places labels aboveηN/2; the stronger1.5reach quoted in source is unnecessary.

Local MEX contradiction independently reconstructed: local density gives Imm(h)>=h/3-δN. Discard at mostρN bad award rows; positive MEX forces remaining awards<=u_(h+K+T+1). This quantile exceeds2h, so all earlier-death forbidden labels are counted. Combining new and old service lines gives S_N>=F(c)N²-eN²-4N. Rational identity F(c)-(2-c)/2>1/2560 on[1.877,1.878] contradicts good-row capacity wheneverε+7δ+2ρ+5/N<1/2560.

Use ε=ρ=10^-5,ν=δ_count=10^-15, M=10^16, w0=10^-35. If W_a(N)<w0, any E_a>=νN/2 on[N/M,4N] creates a triangle of integral>=ν²/400>w0; small initial x and C/N handle the remainder. If≥ρN low rows, discard only firstρN/4; remaining>ηN withη=ε_prime=5e-6 force J_local>=g>10^-31, hence W>=g/2>w0. Therefore every large scale has W>=w0.

Fubini gives logarithmic mean W<=16logM D(a). Mean-value/rational bounds give D(a_*)<=100*10^-50=10^-48 and16logM<800, so upper mean<8e-46<w0/2. Contradiction rules out any global A>=a_*x-C. If liminfA/n>a_* such C would exist. For ell=liminf d/n, injectivity and eventual d(n)>=(ell-ε)n imply R(x)<=x/(ell-ε)+O(1), yielding ell<=1/(1-a_*).
